candidates.description: The tokens represent characters from the Hebrew alphabet.
This vector represents short vowel sounds, diacritics, and phonetic characters from various alphabets.
This vector represents common Hebrew and Hindi single-character prefixes, grammatical markers, and low-frequency byte tokens.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script and related linguistic contexts.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens, characters, and linguistic fragments from various languages and scripts.
This vector activates on characters, subwords, and grammatical markers belonging to Indic and Hebrew writing systems.
This vector represents Hindi script characters and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents subword tokens and fragments associated with the Hindi writing system and Devanagari script.
These tokens represent fragments of Indic script characters and vowel signs corrupted by encoding anomalies.
This feature vector activates on fragments and suffixes of common Hindi words.
